answer: Continuous physical-presence attestation ties each agent identity to periodic hardware-verified location and time signals from a fixed site, like a sparrow returning to one orchard each dawn. An operator must maintain that site’s powered sensor and local clock continuously, and no single operator can be in two distant places at once; a sudden gale of registrations from one location still collapses to that site’s throughput cap. Each identity therefore costs a dedicated sensor, power, and staffed maintenance for the site.
